plan: v1: listings posted by people — post, search, report, staff review, saved searches. No scraped or partner sources, no payments, no messaging until their terms are verified and agreed.
summary: OpenVibe.Rent — Find a place, or rent yours out. One place to find and offer things to rent: apartments, rooms, houses, commercial space, parking and storage, and equipment. In this first version every listing is posted by a person on this site: no scraped listings and no partner feeds, no payments, no deposits and no messaging. Search with filters and facets, a listing page with a plain safety note, reports that hide a listing at 3 until staff look, saved searches that count what is new, and a 30-day expiry an owner can renew.
works: Posting: a signed-in person only (an app, agent or service token is refused), at most 10 active listings and 5 new ones a day, 30 days until expiry

The field rules: kind, title ≤120, description ≤4000, price with an ISO 4217 currency from a short list, period, city, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country, optional region/neighbourhood/bedrooms/available-from, https or mailto contact link
A house number with a street is refused in the title, description, city, region and neighbourhood, in the form and the API alike, with a message saying what to write instead
Search: /listings and GET /api/v1/listings with q, kind, city, country, min, max and period, newest first, 30 a page with a cursor, facets for kind and country
A listing page with the safety note word for word, contact link for signed-in viewers only, and JSON-LD as an Offer only where the schema.org type is clear
Reports: one per person per listing, 3 distinct reports hide it from search until staff restore or remove it; a listing staff restored is not hidden again by the same reports
Staff judged by the Network role claim (admin, global_mod), as at OpenVibe.Help; the queue at /staff and GET /api/v1/staff/reports
The owner can edit, renew, hide, show and delete their own listing; nobody else can
Expiry: a timer (server/listings/expiry.js, started by the process entry) marks the 30-day ones expired; an expired listing leaves search and can be renewed
Saved searches (signed in): save the current filters, see what is new since you last looked; alerts by notification come later through OpenVibe.Watch
Pages: /, /listings, /listings/:id, /listings/:id/edit, /post, /mine, /saved, /safety, /staff, /updates — server-rendered, complete without JavaScript, forms are plain POSTs
Same-origin writes for the session cookie, and per-caller budgets shared by the form and the API route
Discovery: robots.txt (disallows /auth/, /api/, /post, /mine, /saved, /staff), sitemap.xml with every active listing (≤1000), llms.txt, llms-full.txt

Tests: posting rules, search and paging and facets, contact hidden from signed-out viewers, report → hide at 3 → staff restore, expiry, owner-only edits, same-origin writes, saved searches, hostile text escaped

Account export and deletion (ADR-033): the listings a person posted, the reports they filed and the searches they saved are exported to OpenVibe.Network on network.account.export_requested and deleted whole on network.account.deleted (a report others left on a deleted listing cascades away with it), with the counts confirmed back; the two Events topics are subscribed at boot (server/identity/account-data.js)
notYet: Listing sources beyond people posting here: scraped and partner feeds arrive only when their terms are verified, and then each listing will carry its provenance (source name, link back, fetched_at)
Alerts that come to you from a saved search (a notification, an email) — they come later through OpenVibe.Watch
Payments, deposits and messaging: not in this version, and not part of the plan until the safety and legal side is settled
Its service and capability manifests in openvibe-contracts (contracts-service is rent) and registration with OpenVibe.Services
A deployment: the service is not yet deployed by OpenVibe.Host
features: listing pages with a safety note
deployment: openvibe-ovh: unit openvibe-rent.service on 127.0.0.1:5010 (git checkout /opt/openvibe.rent, env /etc/openvibe/rent.env, database ov_rent), deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy rent`; public at https://openvibe.rent since 2026-10-08.
